senses.gloss:
ज The third letter of the second class of consonants, corresponding
to the letter J in jet.

ज mfn. (जः-जा-जं)
 1. Speedy, swift.
 2. Eaten.
 3. Victorious, triumph-
ant, conquering or a conqueror. (जः)
 1. A name of Siva.
 2. A
name of VIṢṆU.
 3. Birth, production.
 4. A parent, a progenitor.
5. Poison.
 6. Enjoyment.
 7. Light, Iustre.
 8. Speed.
 9. An imp-
a goblin.
 E. जन् to bear or to born, जि to conquer, or other roots,
and ड aff.
